'''Blackmoon Leader''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the leader of [[Blackmoon Squadron]], a [[New Republic Defense Fleet]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that fought at the second [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. During that battle, [[Yakown Reth]] flew as [[Borleias/Legends|Blackmoon]] Leader.<ref name="RD" />
